children: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani on Sunday announced the formation of Doha Investment, a new division of the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) dedicated to developing the country's domestic investments.
The move represents a departure for a sovereign wealth fund long focused on building wealth overseas.
